original_test_intent: Validate the PSU board's I2C/PMBus management path and expected populated power devices without changing output, policy, redundancy or telemetry state.
original_method: No method can be authorized from the placeholder source: Engineering must define PSU population, BMC controller/mux route, addresses, permitted non-mutating transactions and response/health criteria before fresh review.
manual_activity: Power/platform owners must supply the PSU-board topology, populated PSU identity, PMBus-safe read list, redundancy baseline and independent recovery before bus access.
safety_requirements: Do not scan all buses or PMBus command space
Do not access unknown PSU addresses
Do not issue quick-write, force or any write-capable transaction
Confirm stable redundancy and load before an approved read
Stop on output, telemetry, redundancy, management or bus change
agent_execution_scope: Perform no bus discovery or PSU read
Keep fan/PDB and PSU-board evidence separate
engineer_actions: Define BMC/mux/address and read-only PMBus matrix
Set power, telemetry and redundancy acceptance

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: A host-wide i2cdetect loop does not identify the PSU-board mux branch or distinguish inventory, telemetry and command-space behavior. It may issue transactions to live PMBus devices and omits slot/redundancy evidence while truncating the address grid.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: BLOCKED: no PSU I2C/PMBus command until the board, slot, mux, address and permitted-register contract is approved.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: I2C PSU_BD and the two-minute time estimates remain source facts; no PSU count, address or transaction is guessed.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: After approval, use the BMC/OOB path to read only explicitly safe identity/status/telemetry fields on named populated PSU slots, correlate them to FRU/SDR/SEL and measured redundancy state, and prove no output or policy change.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Turns an absent procedure into a slot- and command-allowlisted power-domain check rather than discovery scanning.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: A visible I2C address does not establish PSU identity, correct slot mapping, valid telemetry, redundancy health or non-mutating behavior.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: PMBus-capable supplies expose both benign reads and state-changing commands; probing the wrong path can degrade power monitoring or redundancy even when no explicit write tool is selected.

project_override_considerations: Treat PSU_BD I2C as BMC/platform-management scope; require controller/mux, PSU/slot/address map, approved PMBus registers and expected output before any operation.
expected_evidence: Approved PSU_BD/PMBus specification and fresh review
PSU slot, serial, model, firmware and redundancy identity
Complete raw responses correlated with FRU/SDR and nominal telemetry
Pre/post input/output, load, fan, redundancy, SEL and management health

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: The row is internally consistent but non-executable: both procedure and criteria defer to an unavailable PSU-board specification.

blocked_analysis.analysis: Neither package availability nor operator approval defines which live PSU/PMBus endpoint and command is safe or what response passes. The missing power-domain specification is an irreducible target and operation blocker.

engineering_decision_request.question: Define Functionality row 1802 Wistron-HW-00004-V003 I2C PSU_BD: exact PSU-board and populated PSU/slot identities, BMC/OOB controller and mux route, address and permitted PMBus register/read matrix, reserved exclusions, telemetry/redundancy acceptance, aborts and independent power recovery; preserve Master placeholders and require fresh review.

review_improvement: Separates PSU identity/telemetry reads from hazardous PMBus command space and blocks the case until power-domain semantics exist.
independent_technical_reasoning: PMBus shares an electrical transport with I2C but exposes a command model capable of controlling or faulting power devices. Enumeration cannot prove that a response belongs to the intended PSU slot or that redundant output remained healthy. A safe review therefore needs the PSU population, mux route and register-level allowlist before even a nominal discovery step.
